environment: Isolated Ubuntu 24.04 amd64 root filesystem with private network/PID namespaces; actual native daemons; 8 GiB host

application_tests.runtime: Ubuntu Python 3.12 and distribution Flask/cryptography packages; disposable test databases on private tmpfs

browser_checks: Passed existing mail/admin/mobile flows plus token creation, scope validation, replacement/revocation, light/dark/mobile layouts, escaped hostile labels, clipboard-denial fallback, secret cleanup, and token reauthentication. Disposable real-backend create/replace/revoke browser smoke also passed.
mail_integration: Passed actual SMTP, STARTTLS, sender restrictions including revocation during DATA, DKIM verification, LMTP, IMAPS, web send/Sent/drafts/attachments/archive/trash, account disabling, loopback bindings, canonical HTTP hostname, uncompressed session responses, secure cookies and reauthentication/bearer rotation; bearer send/partial recipients, read without Seen mutation, stale UIDVALIDITY rejection, multipart API drafts/replace/attachments, flags/moves/delete scopes, public credential rejection, per-token sender restrictions and revocation during DATA

idle_sample.interpretation: Observed after the synthetic native/API workload and two minutes idle; not a universal minimum, zero-CPU claim, or load-capacity guarantee.

package_install_estimate.scope: Baseline APT estimate for the unchanged package set on a minimal Ubuntu rootfs, including test tools; excludes base OS, mail storage, backups and download caches.

not_qualified: Native systemd lifecycle and fail2ban journal bans
Backup restoration on a different host
systemd_static_validation: Unit syntax passed on systemd 255 with generators and dependency recursion disabled; runtime lifecycle unqualified

api_update.scope: Fresh-install token tables/revocation triggers, private transport credentials, versioned API and admin token UI; existing KagNode branding and paths retained.
